name: Pyannote-Speaker-Diarization
headline: Open-source speaker diarization model identifying "who spoke when" in audio recordings.
description: Pyannote Speaker Diarization is an open-source speaker diarization model that identifies "who spoke when" in an audio recording. It detects per-frame speaker activity and encodes speaker identity, enabling accurate multi-speaker attribution in meetings, interviews, and other multi-party conversations.
